description: Offband radio preset overlay. These entries are added to the MeshCore preset list mirrored in meshcore-upstream.json, and win over it when a title matches. Edit this file to add, change or retire a preset; the app picks the change up on its next refresh, with no app release. See SCHEMA.md.

presets.title: USA - Arizona
presets.notes: SF9/CR8 per zjs81/meshcore-open#507 (Tucson / Phoenix alignment). Unconfirmed by an Arizona authority; owner decision 2026-10-01.

presets.title: USA - Philly Mesh
presets.notes: phillymesh.net, 2026-10-01: 919.500 / 500 kHz / SF10 / CR 4/5 / path hash mode 1 (2-byte). Replaces their original 902.25 guidance. TX power not published; 20 dBm matches the US entries.

presets.title: USA - OKI-Mesh 500kHz Test
presets.notes: docs.okimesh.org 500kHz-testing (test started 2026-09-23). OKI has not settled on a frequency; expect this to change. TX power not published; 20 dBm matches the US entries.
